summary: Defines the rules for the data sent when a user creates a doctor share link.
purpose: Makes sure a share request has a valid email, phone, expiry and resource list before anything is saved.
why: Likely reason: keeps bad data out of share records and sets a maximum lifetime of 90 days.
how: Lists each field with its checks: doctor name as text, doctor email in email format, doctor phone as text, expiry from 1 to 90 days, resource list as text items, and access level as text.
inputs: The request body with doctor name, email, phone, expiry days, shared resources and access level.
outputs: A checked object for the share service. Also describes the fields in the API documentation.
risks: Resource names and access level accept any text, not a fixed list. The service defaults access to read only, but this file does not enforce it. Doctor details are personal data, and nothing here limits what is stored.
debug: For a 400 error, read the message, which names the field. Check the value against the limits: expiry 1 to 90, valid email.
